unstuck_said.text: Opened issue polycratia/paygate402#1 as dhyabi2 (2026-10-03): proposed a nano network in Accepts beside Base/USDC - PayTo already carries recipient, for network nano verification is public RPC account_info (balance + pending) on paid request, paid-by value is the block hash any stranger can re-check; replay guard is the chains receive-once. Kept paygate402 own claim-vs-finding distinction (facilitator now returns a block not a claim). Additive. Open-research disclosure included. See https://github.com/polycratia/paygate402/issues/1
